description.fr-FR: Les sermons de Bossuet, ordonnés selon l’année liturgique : Toussaint, Avent, Noël, Circoncision, Épiphanie, Carême, Semaine sainte, Pâques, Pentecôte, fêtes de la Vierge, vêtures et professions religieuses, sermon sur l’unité de l’Église (1681), exhortations aux Ursulines de Meaux, pensées chrétiennes. Édition Lachat (1863), avec ses plans, abrégés et fragments.
description.en-US: Bossuet’s sermons in the order of the liturgical year: All Saints, Advent, Christmas, Circumcision, Epiphany, Lent, Holy Week, Easter, Pentecost, feasts of Our Lady, clothings and professions, the sermon on the unity of the Church (1681), exhortations to the Ursulines of Meaux, Christian thoughts. Lachat edition (1863), with its outlines, abridgements and fragments.
description.pt-BR: Os sermões de Bossuet, na ordem do ano litúrgico: Todos os Santos, Advento, Natal, Circuncisão, Epifania, Quaresma, Semana Santa, Páscoa, Pentecostes, festas de Nossa Senhora, tomadas de hábito e profissões, sermão sobre a unidade da Igreja (1681), exortações às Ursulinas de Meaux, pensamentos cristãos. Edição Lachat (1863), com seus planos, resumos e fragmentos.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of the Lachat edition, volume008-011 (all pages) and volume012/034.htm. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
